description: If a relation has a total recursive characteristic function and every input has a witness, search for its least witness is total recursive.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.witnessed_search_total {k : ℕ}
  {P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args (k + 1) → Prop}
  (hP :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.TotalRecursive
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.lift
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.characteristic P)))
  (hex :
    ∀ (x : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args k),
      ∃ n, P (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x n)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.TotalRecursive
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.predicateSearch P)
